usageNote: hardly是'几乎不'，加强版的not！表示很费劲、快搞不定了，带点抱怨语气，超日常！

examples.en: This box is so heavy, I can hardly move it!
examples.zh: 这箱子太重了，我几乎搬不动！

examples.en: The sofa is stuck against the wall — I can hardly move it an inch.
examples.zh: 沙发卡在墙边，我连一寸都推不动。
